biography: Clara Sterling lives in Bend, Oregon with her golden retriever, Barnaby. Clara was born on June 14, 1941 in Portland, Oregon. Her husband was Arthur Sterling, born on March 22, 1939. Clara and Arthur were married on September 18, 1965 in Eugene, Oregon. Arthur passed away in October 2021. Clara worked as a beloved high school biology teacher for 32 years. She loves botany, tending her backyard flower garden, watercolor landscape painting, and baking marionberry pies. Clara has two daughters, Elena and Beatrice. Elena is married to David Chen and lives in Seattle, Washington; they have two children, Maya and Lucas. Beatrice is married to Thomas Wright and lives in Denver, Colorado; they have a son named Owen. Clara's longtime friend Evelyn visits every Tuesday to bake and volunteer at the Cascade Botanical Greenhouse.
